additionalProjects.name: HackNYU Home and 2024 Website
additionalProjects.description: As Technical Director of HackNYU for 2023 and 2024, I led the development of our flagship website using React and integrated Mailchimp for seamless event management. The site features dynamic registration flows, sponsor showcases, and interactive elements that enhanced user engagement for 500+ hackathon participants.

additionalProjects.name: Youtube-Sumarizr
additionalProjects.description: Submitted to PeddieHacks 2022 ($1000-cash Passion Prize and Best Education Track). This project allows users (intended to be students or teachers) to get auto-chapters or summaries of any youtube video. They can then choose to ask a ML bot questions about these chapters and get answers. This allows students to absorb content fast and easily.

additionalProjects.name: Trash-ure Map
additionalProjects.description: Won First Place in FiveHacks, Second Place in MergeHacks and Data Grind Hacks. A social media app for litter. Users post litter they've found online. Google Cloud Vision identifies the product (such as a Coca-cola can) and stores it in the database along with the location it is found. A crowdmap of the found data in respective regions is publicly provided, with the intention of being proof of litter and to hold companies like Coca-cola accountable for their litter.

computerVisionProjects.name: Images of the Russian Empire: Pixels
computerVisionProjects.description: This project involves aligning separate RGB channels of an image to create a cohesive RGB image. Techniques used include Normalized Cross Correlation and Gaussian Pyramid.

computerVisionProjects.name: Multiresolution Blending
computerVisionProjects.description: This project explores convolutional filters and image frequencies for edge detection, blurring, sharpening, morphing, and multi-resolution blending. It demonstrates how frequencies can manipulate images and create blending effects, similar to those seen in movies and animations.

computerVisionProjects.name: Face Morphing and Averaging with Delaunay Triangulation
computerVisionProjects.description: This project is about computer vision and image processing tasks on human faces, particularly face warping, face morphing, and face averaging. It involves defining correspondences, computing the 'mid-way face', creating a morphing sequence, computing the 'mean face' of a population, and creating caricatures.

computerVisionProjects.name: Automatic Image Alignment and Panorama Stitching
computerVisionProjects.description: This project involves taking several pictures of the same scene from different perspectives and automating the correspondence selection for image alignment. It includes detecting features, filtering them, matching features between images, computing homography, warping images, and blending them together.

computerVisionProjects.name: Traning and Using Diffusion Image Generation Models
computerVisionProjects.description: This project is about playing with diffusion models, implementing diffusion sampling loops, and exploring the power of diffusion models. In the second part, we go deeper into the architecture of the diffusion model by implementing a unet and ddpm (Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models) from scratch. A denoising diffusion model is essentially a UNet. We can implement a UNet from scratch. The UNet is a neural network that takes an image and predicts the noise to add to the image to denoise it.

computerVisionProjects.name: Facial Keypoint Detection with Deep Learning
computerVisionProjects.description: Facial landmark detection using multiple deep learning approaches in PyTorch. Implemented custom CNN architecture, transfer learning with pretrained ResNet (MSE 2.9), DINO feature extraction, and UNet heatmap detector achieving best performance (MSE 2.3). Evaluated coordinate regression vs. heatmap-based methods for 68-point facial keypoint localization.

hackathonProjects.name: Command-Line Adventure and Fantasy Game
hackathonProjects.description: This project was a semester-long compilation of class assignments built up on each other. The repository is not made public. I used the projects to learn C++ in it's entirety, including multiple inheritance, pointers, memory allocation and deallocation, operator overloading, polymorphism, and more.

meshGeometricProcessingProjects.name: Mesh Implicit Reconstruction
meshGeometricProcessingProjects.description: Point cloud to surface reconstruction using Moving Least Squares (MLS) interpolation. Implements constraint-based surface reconstruction, implicit function approximation, and marching tetrahedra for mesh extraction from zero level sets.

meshGeometricProcessingProjects.name: Laplacian Surface Editing
meshGeometricProcessingProjects.description: Interactive 3D mesh deformation using multi-resolution surface representation. Implements bi-Laplacian smoothing, handle-based transformations, and detail transfer using cotangent Laplacian operators and thin-plate energy minimization.

meshGeometricProcessingProjects.name: Cage-Based Mesh Deformation
meshGeometricProcessingProjects.description: Harmonic coordinates for character articulation using space-based deformation. Implements cage triangulation, harmonic weight computation, barycentric interpolation, and interactive mesh deformation through cage manipulation.

meshGeometricProcessingProjects.name: Vector Field Poisson Reconstruction
meshGeometricProcessingProjects.description: Mesh parameterization through vector field design and scalar field reconstruction. Implements smooth tangent vector field interpolation, least-squares gradient fitting, and harmonic/LSCM parameterization for 3D-to-2D mesh flattening.

renderingRealTimeProjects.name: CPU Triangle Rasterizer
renderingRealTimeProjects.description: Full rasterization pipeline implementation with triangle rendering, supersampling anti-aliasing, barycentric coordinate interpolation, and texture mapping. Features bilinear interpolation, mipmapping, and level sampling for optimized texture filtering with minimal computational overhead.

renderingRealTimeProjects.name: Bezier Curves & Loop Subdivision
renderingRealTimeProjects.description: Mathematical foundations of Bezier curves and surfaces using De Casteljau's algorithm. Triangle mesh manipulation with half-edge data structure, implementing edge flips, splits, and Loop Subdivision for smooth mesh upsampling and refinement.

renderingRealTimeProjects.name: OpenGL Path Tracer with BVH
renderingRealTimeProjects.description: Monte Carlo path tracer with realistic lighting simulation. Features ray generation, intersection testing, bounding volume hierarchies (BVH), direct/global illumination, and adaptive sampling for complex scene rendering with physically accurate lighting.

renderingRealTimeProjects.name: Cloth Simulation & GLSL Shaders
renderingRealTimeProjects.description: Physically-based cloth simulation using mass-spring systems with numerical integration. Implements collision detection, spatial hashing, and advanced GLSL shaders including Blinn-Phong, texture mapping, bump/displacement mapping, and environment mapping.

renderingRealTimeProjects.name: Vision Pro MSL Aberration Simulator
renderingRealTimeProjects.description: GPU-based path tracing on Apple Vision Pro using Metal Shading Language. Simulates vision aberrations with thin-lens ray generation, per-ray dioptric variation from clinical eye parameters (SPH, CYL, AXIS), and realistic defocus pattern modeling.

renderingRealTimeProjects.name: WebGL GPU Ray Tracer
renderingRealTimeProjects.description: Real-time ray tracing and ray marching implementation in WebGL with GPU acceleration. Features Phong shading model, real-time lighting calculations, and interactive 3D scene rendering directly in the browser.

renderingRealTimeProjects.name: 3D Optical Bench Simulation
renderingRealTimeProjects.description: Interactive 3D optical bench system using WebGL ray marching. Features dynamic lens manipulation, convex/concave transformations, signed distance function blending, real-time ray visualization, and procedurally generated lens environments with full 3D camera controls.

renderingRealTimeProjects.name: Interactive Bezier Curve Tutorial
renderingRealTimeProjects.description: Educational simulation for Bezier curve mathematics with interactive point manipulation, font rendering integration, and real-time curve visualization. Demonstrates De Casteljau's algorithm through hands-on learning with draggable control points.
